title: Masked-attention Mask Transformer for Universal Image Segmentation
layout_note: Overview on the left, a dashed vertical rule, then a tall detail panel on the right showing one decoder layer. In the overview the backbone sits bottom-left, the pixel decoder is a large green trapezoid running diagonally up-right holding feature maps of increasing size, and the transformer decoder is a blue container above it; slanted arrows rise from each feature map to one decoder block, so features of different resolution feed successive blocks.
grouping: Large coloured containers group parts: a rounded light-blue box titled 'Transformer Decoder' with 'L x' holds three grey blocks; a green trapezoid labelled 'Pixel Decoder' along its slanted edge holds four lilac feature maps. The detail panel is a single rounded light-grey container with a vertical stack of white 'add & norm' boxes alternating with tinted operation boxes, and residual arrows looping up the right side.
shapes_depth: Flat fills with thin dark outlines, small corner radii. Backbone is an orange trapezoid; image features are lilac rectangles drawn in perspective, growing in size along the pixel-decoder trapezoid. Queries are a vertical rounded bar of four coloured squares (teal, orange, blue, amber) entering the decoder on the left; the same coloured row returns at the top of the detail panel as its output. Outputs 'class' and 'mask' are small cream boxes; the mask is formed by a circled times between the decoder output and the largest feature map. In the detail panel, attention boxes have V, K, Q written at their input ports.
proposed_highlight: The changed operation is the only strongly saturated box in the detail panel: 'masked attention' in a deeper pink fill with the word 'masked' in bold, while the rest of the layer is white or pale. A cream 'mask' input box enters it from outside the container, the same cream as the overview's mask output.
lesson: Draw the multi-scale pixel decoder as a widening trapezoid of feature maps whose sizes grow along it, with one arrow from each map to a successive decoder block, so 'one resolution per layer' is read from geometry alone.
notes: Venue and year from the arXiv comment ('CVPR 2022'). The left overview has no panel title; the right panel is the inside of one Transformer decoder layer.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: the meta-architecture on the left (backbone, pixel-decoder pyramid, Transformer decoder) and, past a dashed vertical rule, one decoder layer opened on the right with its bold red 'masked attention' block at the bottom

relations.form: a grey rounded panel at right shows one layer as a bottom-to-top stack (masked attention, add & norm, self-attention, add & norm, FFN, add & norm) separated from the overview by a dashed line
the pixel decoder's three increasingly large lavender feature maps each send one diagonal arrow up into one of the three successive grey layer boxes inside the blue Transformer Decoder

orange backbone trapezoid, a bar, the green pixel-decoder wedge, left to right; and coloured query squares entering the decoder at left, passing three layer boxes ('Lx') to class and mask outputs at right
the decoder output meets an arrow up from the largest feature map at a ⊗ node that produces 'mask'

channels.colour: fill = component: orange backbone, green pixel decoder, blue Transformer decoder, lavender image features, pale yellow mask/class, red masked attention (the novelty), pink self-attention, teal FFN; the four coloured squares = individual queries
channels.shape: trapezoid/wedge = CNN backbone and decoder; rounded box = layer; column of coloured squares = query set
channels.line: solid arrows = data; residual connections drawn as right-side elbows in the detail
channels.frame: blue rounded box = the Transformer decoder; grey rounded panel = one decoder layer; dashed rule = overview vs detail

quality.strengths: The novelty is the most saturated block (red, bold 'masked'), the multi-scale feeding is shown by geometry (pyramid levels growing left to right under successive layers), and queries, image features and mask are drawn as data entering the detailed layer.
quality.weaknesses: The detail panel is not tied to the overview by matching tint or a callout (blue decoder vs grey panel); the three diagonal arrows from the pyramid cut up through the decoder's edge at different angles; residual wires bend around the right side of the stack.

insights.structure: Overview on the left and, across a dashed vertical rule, a tall grey detail panel of one decoder layer on the right; in the overview an orange Backbone trapezoid sits bottom-left, a green Pixel Decoder trapezoid widens diagonally up-right, and a light-blue 'Transformer Decoder L x' container with three grey blocks sits above it.
insights.data: Image features are lilac planes that grow in size along the pixel-decoder trapezoid; queries are a vertical rounded bar of four coloured squares that reappears as the output row at the top of the detail panel; class and mask outputs are small cream boxes.
insights.emphasis: In the detail panel the 'masked attention' box is the only saturated (deep pink) block with 'masked' in bold, and a cream 'mask' input enters it from outside the container in the same cream as the overview's mask output.
insights.flow: Overview reads backbone to pixel decoder left to right, then slanted arrows rise from successive feature maps into successive decoder blocks, and the decoder output meets the largest feature map at a circled-times to give the mask; the detail panel reads bottom to top with residual arrows looping up its right side.
insights.avoid: The long slanted arrows from feature maps to decoder blocks cross the gap at different angles and are hard to pair at a glance; the overview never shows where the detail panel's layer sits beyond the shared colours.

arrangement.units: two side-by-side regions split by a dashed rule: an unframed overview with coloured containers (blue decoder box, green trapezoid) and a framed grey detail panel of one layer
arrangement.inputs_as: query squares at left of the decoder; image features, mask and query features as small glyphs at the bottom of the detail panel
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn; class and mask output boxes at right of the decoder
